# Python Code-based Agent Template

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "My Python Agent"
  description: "A Python-based agent using custom code."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["assistant"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["input"]
    properties:
      input:
        type: "string"
        title: "Input"
output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "custom"
    entry_point: "src.main:agent"

  mode: "standard"
  lifecycle: "serverless"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: true
  max_steps: 20

.venv
venv
env
virtualenv

__pycache__
*.pyc
*.pyo
*.pyd

.env
.env.local
.env.*
secrets.json
credentials.json

.git
.gitignore
.DS_Store

.vscode
.idea

.pytest_cache
.mypy_cache
build
dist
*.egg-info

*.pt
*.h5
*.safetensors
node_modules

# Define your agent logic here.
# The object must be named 'agent' to match charm.yaml entry_point.

def agent(inputs):
    return f"Hello from Charm! Input received: {inputs}"
